findings: Game direction is documented and three visual review candidates now exist under data/source_art/.
The candidates are not approved production sources until the human storyboard, model sheet and spritesheet gates pass.
Benchmarks may guide rhythm and readability only; they cannot define silhouette, palette, layout, music or identity.

game_design_context.gameplay_role: Side-view action platformer stage with run, jump, shoot, one common enemy and one simple mini-boss.
interaction_context: Player reads platforms and sentry shots before committing to jump or fire.
Mini-boss uses telegraphed attacks and a clear vulnerability window.

must_preserve.expected: Blue/cyan energy with amber danger and magenta/lime accents, avoiding one-note blue-only composition.
Circuit-board industrial station, not character/IP-derived robot lab imagery.

secondary_motion: clear landing compression if approved in animation pass
expression_requirements: player silhouette must read without copying protected armor, helmet or arm-cannon shapes
state_fantasy_checks: run feels like urgent repair work, not military march
shot feels like maintenance pulse, not weapon clone

background_scene_context.depth_role_map: BG_B supports energy depth; BG_A owns solids and readable foreground.
background_scene_context.layer_plan: scene_local_preload until art and budget prove otherwise.
background_scene_context.sprite_readability_policy: Actors must separate from cyan background through value, outline and amber/magenta accents.
